instruction:
Open the RCSB PDB Structure Summary for 1TUP. Report the complete structure title, released date, experimental method, resolution, protein molecule name, protein source organism, and every unique ligand ID displayed.

Stopping condition: Stop after all requested structure, experimental, protein, organism, and ligand fields have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use the 1TUP Structure Summary page.
- Report the protein organism; do not treat DNA rows displaying N/A as protein organisms.
- List each unique ligand ID once even if it occurs in multiple chains.
- Preserve the displayed date, resolution, and units exactly.
